title: Stimulating After Recovery From Traumatic Brain Injury
official: Stimulating After Recovery From Traumatic Brain Injury
summary: This is a preliminary, prospective interventional study to investigate the feasibility of using transcutaneous alternating current stimulation (TACS) after a traumatic brain injury (TBI) to improve cognitive function and decision-making.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults 18 years and older
* Diagnosis of a mild to moderate TBI (GCS \> 8 on admission)
* Able to perform a computerized assessment
* Willing to attend all scheduled appointments
* Able to undergo the informed consent process

Healthy participants:

* Adults 18 years and older
* Able to perform a computerized assessment
* Willing to attend all scheduled appointments
* Able to undergo the informed consent process

Exclusion Criteria:

* Open wound on scalp
* Severe TBI diagnosis or GCS of less than 8 on admission
* Non-English speaking
* Incarcerated
* Implanted defibrillator or pacemaker
* Visual impairment that hinders ability to complete computerized assessments

Healthy subject exclusion criteria:

* Less than 18 years of age
* Open wound on scalp
* TBI diagnosis
* Non-English speaking
* Incarcerated
* Implanted defibrillator or pacemaker
* Visual impairment that hinders ability to complete computerized assessments
